info.title: NortFox API
info.description: The API of NortFox, an open-source Swedish accounting system. Amounts travel as decimal strings, never as JSON numbers.

version.description: The version of the server that answered.

type.description: A URI for the kind of problem. NortFox sends about:blank, and the code says what went wrong.

title.description: The status in words, such as Bad Request.

detail.description: What went wrong, in an English sentence.

code.description: What went wrong, as a stable kebab-case code. Clients rely on this.

errors.description: For invalid-request: what is wrong with each field.

permission.description: For permission-missing: the permission the operation needs.

pointer.description: For a rule's refusal that concerns one field: that field's JSON Pointer.

data.description: For a rule's refusal: the facts behind it.

Problem.description: Problem details (RFC 9457) with a stable code.

code.description: What is wrong with the field, as a stable kebab-case code.

detail.description: The same in an English sentence.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the field in the operation's input: the query parameters, the body's fields and, for a write, idempotencyKey. An empty pointer is the whole input.

data.description: The facts behind the code, such as expected, minimum, maximum or allowed. Absent when there are none.

FieldProblem.description: What is wrong with one field of a request.

get.summary: Check that the server is up
get.description: Answers as soon as the server runs. It reads no data.

x-nortfox.tool: Checks that the NortFox server is up, and gives its version. It reads no data.

400.description: The request does not fit the operation. Each field problem names its field.

500.description: The server failed. The answer holds no detail of the error.
